definitions.full: H5784. ur עוּר noun [masculine] chaff (J Aramaic (Talmud, rare), Syriac ; Arabic , mote (in eye, tending to cause blindness [ עִוֵּר ]) according to Arabic Lexicons, Lane 2195 ); — absolute ׳ע Dan 2:35 (in simile). [ עֵז ], עִזִּין see ענז
